_docs._about: All Discord IDs and server settings live here. config.js loads this file and flattens it so the rest of the bot can access values directly.
_docs.APPLICATION_ID: Your bot application ID. Discord Developer Portal → Your App → General Information → Application ID.
_docs.GUILD_ID: The Discord server ID. Right-click the server icon → Copy Server ID. Requires Developer Mode enabled.
_docs.MINECRAFT_SERVER: Hostname or IP of the Minecraft server shown by /status.
_docs.MINECRAFT_PORT: Query port of the Minecraft server (Java default: 25565).
_docs.PANEL_MESSAGE_ID: Reserved internally — leave null. Used internally to track the ticket panel message.
_docs.APPLICATION_TIMEOUT_HOURS: Number of hours an applicant has to complete their application before it expires.
_docs.DM_USER_ID: User ID that receives a private DM when a message is deleted in MONITORED_CATEGORY.

CHANNELS._about: All channel IDs the bot reads from or writes to.
CHANNELS.TICKET_CHANNEL: Channel where the ticket selection panel is posted (dropdown to open a ticket).
CHANNELS.SUPPORT_CATEGORY: Category ID under which new ticket channels are automatically created.
CHANNELS.TRANSCRIPT_CHANNEL: Channel where ticket transcripts (text files + summary embeds) are archived after closing.
CHANNELS.LOG_CHANNEL: Primary moderation log channel — receives ban/kick/mute/unmute events.
CHANNELS.MESSAGE_LOG_CHANNEL: Logs every message deletion and edit.
CHANNELS.CHANNEL_LOG_CHANNEL: Logs channel creations, deletions, and edits.
CHANNELS.ROLE_LOG_CHANNEL: Logs role creations, deletions, and updates.
CHANNELS.MEMBER_LOG_CHANNEL: Logs members joining and leaving the server.
CHANNELS.USER_LOG_CHANNEL: Logs user-level changes: username and avatar updates.
CHANNELS.WELCOME_CHANNEL: Channel where a welcome message is sent when a new member joins.
CHANNELS.MONITORED_CATEGORY: Category ID whose message deletions trigger an extra DM notification to DM_USER_ID.
CHANNELS.PROMOTION_LOG_CHANNEL: Channel where promotion and demotion announcements are posted.
CHANNELS.APPLICATION_PANEL_CHANNEL: Channel where the application selection panel is posted.
CHANNELS.APPLICATION_REVIEW_CHANNEL: Default channel where completed applications are posted for staff review (fallback when no category-specific channel is configured).

APPLICATION_CATEGORY_SPECIFIC._about: Per-role application review channel. Applications for each role are posted to the matching channel instead of APPLICATION_REVIEW_CHANNEL.

ROLES._about: Role IDs that are automatically assigned by the bot.
ROLES.JOIN_ROLE: Role given to every new human member on join.
ROLES.BOT_ROLE: Role given to every new bot added to the server.

STAFF_CONFIG._about: All staff rank role IDs and hierarchy rules.
STAFF_CONFIG.STAFF_ROLE: Role ID shared by all active staff members.
STAFF_CONFIG.MANAGEMENT_ROLE: Role ID for management — required for /promote, /demote, /massrole, and application reviews.
STAFF_CONFIG.RANK_ROLES: Mapping of rank name → role ID. Every promotable rank must be listed here. Key names must match application categories exactly.
STAFF_CONFIG.ROLE_HIERARCHY: When a rank is assigned, all ranks listed in its array are also added.
STAFF_CONFIG.STAFF_RANKS: Ranks that also receive the shared STAFF_ROLE when promoted.

CATEGORY_PERMISSIONS._about: Defines each ticket category: its display name, which staff roles can see the channel, and the embed accent color (decimal — use a hex converter e.g. hexcolorcodes.com).
CATEGORY_PERMISSIONS.general: General support tickets — visible to the general support role.
CATEGORY_PERMISSIONS.appeal: Punishment appeal tickets — visible to senior staff.
